## What is still open

- **PR #247 awaits green CI and Maya’s approval.** She needs the Orbitly loss figure for Thursday’s customer call: **~1.18 million legitimate events (8.1% of iOS volume)**, excluding 4,352 genuine replays. [2][1]
- Add an alert when the ingest dead-letter queue exceeds **1,000 messages**, before Friday’s incident review on 20 November. [7]
- After #247 is deployed, replay Orbitly and Zest from landing starting **13 November 09:40 UTC** through deployment; running earlier would drop the events again. Then confirm Orbitly’s dedupe-drop counter stays near zero. [1]
- Send the iOS team your drafted note: **3.2.1 must restore UUID `event_id` values**, as required by the ingest contract and relied upon by other consumers. [1]

## What changed

- Noa finalized the 12/11 postmortem in #233 and will present it at Friday’s incident review. [3]

## What you did

- You traced Orbitly’s funnel loss to kestrel-ios 3.2.0 replacing UUIDs with per-session counters, causing #240 to discard distinct events across devices. Zest’s pilot app was affected too, losing 3,812 events. [1]
- You changed dedupe to key on `project_id:device_id:event_id`, preserved replay protection, and passed the full test suite and lint before opening #247. [1]
